//: Hand-maintained: the ONLY license input that is not read from a dependency manifest.
and verified by `go run ./scripts/licenses -check` (CI job 'licenses'). See README.md here.
components: things that ship but are not a Go module or an npm package (the project itself,
the Go standard library, embedded data, copied source, fonts). Fields:
name, version ('@toolchain' = the toolchain line of desktop/go.mod), license (SPDX id),
kind (project|go|npm|font|data, picks the label in the Licenses view), source (URL),
why (one line: what it is and where it is used), copyright (the notice line for NOTICE),
text (license text, path relative to desktop/licenses/), copy_from (optional, repo-relative:
the text is generated from that file instead of being hand-kept), copies (optional,
repo-relative paths the text is also written to, e.g. beside a shipped font),
notice (true: the text is reproduced in full in NOTICE).
Unused hand-kept files under data/ and fonts/ are an error: every text must be named here.
npm_texts: npm packages whose published tarball carries no license file (the declared license
is MIT in each case). The text is the upstream repository's LICENSE, kept under data/npm/.
It is used only when the package ships none, and its detected license must match the
